description: The SAGE taxonomy is a data-driven framework of four distinct recipience processes that feedback interventions target: Self-appraisal (making judgments about oneself, one's traits, or one's behavior), Assessment literacy (understanding the grading process and applying it to make academic judgments),
title: SAGE taxonomy of four recipience processes targeted by feedback interventions

description: The study uses Mamede's salient distracting feature (SDF) paradigm: 12 clinical vignettes based on real patients, presented in three versions (no SDF, SDF at the beginning, SDF at the end) in a within-subject incomplete block design via Qualtrics.
title: Salient distracting feature (SDF) experimental paradigm with time-per-word processing measure

description: Grounded in the Limited Capacity Model of Motivated Mediated Message Processing (LC4MP), SAVVY quantifies information density of both visual and auditory channels per slide-transition-induced event segment.
title: SAVVY content-derived visual and auditory information density metrics
